description:
Cast Jeweled Lotus by paying its mana cost.
When Jeweled Lotus enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Jeweled Lotus.
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Haru triggers, returning Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
